notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 and Fresh-FX
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Honoko's vertical acceleration when jumping and attacking at the same time to bring it in line with normal jump physics.
[*] Fixed stage 1 alternate path being blocked by hitting checkpoint and doubling back.
[*] Added a hidden Skin Select Cabinet to the final boss area, in case you want to make a change at the end!
[/list]

And also, the Fresh-FX companion magazine is available as FREE DLC!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Fixes and additions
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem preventing beating the game on Hard difficulty ending A.
[*] Fixed analog stick diagonal directions when fighting Red Dragon Demolisher.
[*] Added new tutorial TV explaining Honoko's dodge roll to Stage 1.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
This patch contains minor fixes and changes.
[list]
[*] Game now works properly on Steam Deck.
[*] Add audio feedback for Honoko and Cogex weapon throw.
[*] Minor adjustment to Honoko's ground physics.
[*] Cutscenes now play at end of game regardless of mode and settings, so anyone who makes their New Game+ run on All Characters won't miss out on the new story.
[*] Fixed potential problem with disabling cutscenes before starting a new game.
[*] The red phone isn't ready to receive calls, but we'll let you know when it is!
[/list]

notes.title: Street Cleaner 3 Dev Streams
notes.notes:
Want to see the Street Cleaner sequel in development? Join us for dev streams on Twitch!

Creaky Lantern artist and designer Brooks is regularly streaming development of the new game live on Twitch.tv every M/W/F around 1pm Pacific.  Other days may get thrown in for playing games with either Brooks or the Street Cleaner himself!

Follow us at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/creakylantern]https://www.twitch.tv/creakylantern[/url] to get notifications when streams happen, and come chat with us about the game, game development, or whatever.
